label: ya ina ya
title_raw: や否や [やいなや] (ya ina ya)
title: や否や
meaning: As soon as, had hardly... when
meaning_example: As soon as he opened the door, the cat ran out

examples.japanese: 学校に到着するやいなや
examples.body_text:

		As soon as you arrive at the school
